title: MARPOL – Prevention of Pollution from Ships
description: Test your knowledge of the MARPOL Convention, its six technical annexes and the main controls used to prevent pollution from ships.

questions.question: What is the main purpose of the MARPOL Convention?
options: To prevent and minimize pollution of the marine environment from ships
To regulate the construction of passenger terminals
To establish international rules for collision avoidance
To determine minimum wages for seafarers
questions.explanation: MARPOL is the main international convention covering prevention of pollution from ships caused by routine operations or accidents.

questions.question: How many technical annexes are currently included in MARPOL?
options: Four
Five
Six
Seven
questions.explanation: MARPOL currently contains six technical annexes, each dealing with a different type of ship-source pollution.

questions.question: Which MARPOL annex covers pollution by oil?
options: Annex I
Annex II
Annex IV
Annex VI
questions.explanation: Annex I contains regulations for the prevention of pollution by oil.

questions.question: Which MARPOL annex deals with garbage from ships?
options: Annex II
Annex III
Annex V
Annex VI
questions.explanation: Annex V regulates the handling and disposal of garbage from ships.

questions.question: Which MARPOL annex covers air pollution from ships?
options: Annex I
Annex III
Annex V
Annex VI
questions.explanation: Annex VI sets requirements concerning air pollution from ships, including limits on certain exhaust emissions.

questions.question: Which type of pollution is regulated by MARPOL Annex II?
options: Oil carried as fuel or cargo
Noxious liquid substances carried in bulk
Sewage discharged from accommodation spaces
Harmful substances carried in packaged form
questions.explanation: Annex II controls pollution by noxious liquid substances carried in bulk and establishes discharge criteria for their residues.

questions.question: What is the main focus of MARPOL Annex III?
options: Preventing pollution by harmful substances carried in packaged form
Controlling oil discharged from machinery spaces
Regulating sewage treatment systems
Limiting sulphur emissions from ship engines
questions.explanation: Annex III addresses harmful substances transported in packaged form and includes requirements relating to packing, marking, labelling, documentation and stowage.

questions.question: What is a MARPOL Special Area?
options: A sea area where all commercial navigation is prohibited
An area where stricter controls apply to certain operational discharges
A designated anchorage used only by oil tankers
A port area where flag State regulations replace MARPOL
questions.explanation: Special Areas are designated sea areas where stricter controls apply because of their environmental condition, traffic or other characteristics.

questions.question: Which statement correctly describes MARPOL Annex V?
options: It allows plastics to be discharged if they are shredded
It prohibits the disposal of all forms of plastics into the sea
It only applies to garbage generated in cargo areas
It permits plastics to be discharged outside Special Areas
questions.explanation: A central feature of Annex V is the complete prohibition on disposing of plastics into the sea.

questions.question: Which of the following is regulated under MARPOL Annex VI?
options: Sulphur oxide and nitrogen oxide emissions
Oil residues from cargo tanks
Sewage discharged from passenger accommodation
Noxious liquid cargo residues
questions.explanation: Annex VI establishes controls for air pollution, including limits on sulphur oxides, nitrogen oxides and deliberate emissions of ozone-depleting substances.

questions.question: A vessel plans to discharge machinery-space bilge water overboard. Which MARPOL annex is primarily relevant?
options: Annex I
Annex II
Annex IV
Annex V
questions.explanation: Machinery-space bilge water may contain oil and is therefore primarily regulated under Annex I.

questions.question: A chemical tanker is carrying a noxious liquid substance in bulk. Before disposing of cargo residues, which MARPOL annex should be consulted?
options: Annex I
Annex II
Annex III
Annex VI
questions.explanation: Annex II provides discharge criteria and pollution-control measures for noxious liquid substances carried in bulk.

questions.question: A container contains a substance identified as a marine pollutant under the IMDG Code. Which MARPOL annex primarily governs its carriage?
options: Annex II
Annex III
Annex IV
Annex V
questions.explanation: Annex III applies to harmful substances carried in packaged form, including substances identified as marine pollutants under the IMDG Code.

questions.question: A vessel without an approved sewage treatment plant is carrying untreated sewage. The vessel is six nautical miles from the nearest land. What is the correct action?
options: Discharge the sewage because the vessel is more than three nautical miles from land
Retain the sewage onboard until the applicable discharge conditions are satisfied
Transfer the sewage to the bilge system before discharge
Discharge the sewage after recording it in the Garbage Record Book
questions.explanation: Untreated sewage that is not comminuted or disinfected may only be discharged when the applicable Annex IV conditions are met, including the required distance from land.

questions.question: A vessel is four nautical miles from the nearest land and has an approved system for comminuting and disinfecting sewage. Which statement is most accurate?
options: Discharge may be permitted if the other Annex IV conditions are satisfied
Discharge is prohibited unless the vessel is at least twelve nautical miles from land
Discharge is only permitted inside a Special Area
Discharge is regulated under Annex V rather than Annex IV
questions.explanation: Comminuted and disinfected sewage may be discharged more than three nautical miles from the nearest land when the applicable Annex IV requirements are satisfied.

questions.question: A crew member proposes throwing plastic packaging overboard while the vessel is far from land. What is the correct response?
options: Permit the discharge if the plastic is cut into small pieces
Permit the discharge outside a MARPOL Special Area
Prohibit the discharge because Annex V bans disposal of plastics into the sea
Permit the discharge if it is entered in the Oil Record Book
questions.explanation: Annex V prohibits the disposal of all forms of plastics into the sea, regardless of distance from land.

questions.question: During a voyage, a vessel enters an Emission Control Area. Which operational issue becomes particularly important under MARPOL Annex VI?
options: Compliance with more stringent requirements for certain air emissions
Use of reception facilities for chemical cargo residues
Restrictions on discharging untreated sewage
Requirements for marking packaged marine pollutants
questions.explanation: Emission Control Areas apply more stringent standards for emissions such as sulphur oxides, nitrogen oxides and particulate matter.

questions.question: Which statement correctly distinguishes MARPOL Annex II from Annex III?
options: Annex II concerns noxious liquid substances in bulk, while Annex III concerns harmful substances in packaged form
Annex II concerns packaged substances, while Annex III concerns sewage
Annex II concerns garbage, while Annex III concerns oil
Annex II concerns air emissions, while Annex III concerns liquid fuel
questions.explanation: Annex II applies to noxious liquid substances carried in bulk, whereas Annex III applies to harmful substances carried in packaged form.

questions.question: A port State control officer observes an oily discharge and discarded plastic waste from the same vessel. Which annexes are primarily involved?
options: Annex I and Annex V
Annex II and Annex III
Annex III and Annex IV
Annex IV and Annex VI
questions.explanation: Oil pollution is addressed under Annex I, while garbage including plastics is addressed under Annex V.

questions.question: Which combination correctly matches a MARPOL annex with its pollution category?
options: Annex I – oil; Annex IV – sewage; Annex VI – air pollution
Annex II – garbage; Annex III – sewage; Annex V – oil
Annex III – air emissions; Annex IV – packaged goods; Annex VI – sewage
Annex I – chemicals in bulk; Annex II – plastics; Annex V – exhaust emissions
questions.explanation: Annex I concerns oil, Annex IV concerns sewage and Annex VI concerns air pollution from ships.
